messages.author: 191d2160c4d50374
messages.subject: Custom Cdf
parts:
Hi Henrik,

 

I have generated a custom Cdf for HuEx-1_0-st-v2 arrays by combining the BrainArray ENSE & ENSG cdfs for the groups & units respectively, including the mapping files. Is that something which would be worth putting up on the aroma.project website, or is that beyond the scope of the project?

 

Thanks,

 

Steve

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Custom Cdf
parts:
Hi Steve,

great. Yes, it's definitely worth sharing this and I'm happy to do it
via aroma-project.org. If you can provide me with a download link
where I can grab, then I'll put it on the servers. Some description
of the CDF would be useful too; I've create

http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/HuEx-1_0-st-v2/BrainArrayENSEandENSG

which you can access and edit as soon as you login. I've sent you a
separate message with your login.

Thanks

Henrik
